scope: Alt+Shift+Up/Down unread server-channel navigation, shared command registry and custom binding editor
behavior: Fetches fresh unread counts and server-authorized channel trees, including unopened servers; preserves server/channel display order and the active read channel as an anchor.
Excludes muted servers/channels, archived channels, voice channels and nested threads. Does not mark messages read, reveal plaintext or join voice.
At most four server lookups run concurrently. Each HTTP request has a 15 second lifetime. New key presses abort and supersede older lookups.

Account identity, destination identity, live server membership, mute settings and modal ownership are checked before navigation. Failed snapshots show an error instead of navigating through partial results.
English/Turkish help labels explicitly identify server channels. Mentions and private unread conversations are not represented as implemented.
